reference.citation: Donoghue T, Haller M, Peterson EJ, et al. (2020). Parameterizing neural power spectra into periodic and aperiodic components. Nat Neurosci 23(12):1655-1665. Reference impl: fooof (Python). Data: EEG Motor Movement/Imagery Database (eegmmidb), PhysioNet.
reference.description: re-fits the identical per-channel Welch PSD with the canonical Python fooof (matched settings, via reticulate) and compares aperiodic exponents to eegAperiodic's; reports the spatial correlation (0.9803), mean |exponent diff| (0.070), max |diff| (0.251), both engines' mean exponent (specparam 1.384, fooof 1.454), mean fit R^2 (0.932), and the channel count (64)
